name: SPOT raw-MOC binary32 ULP bridge audit
purpose: Measure, without a new transport solve, the exact binary32 representable-step displacement from the captured EVAL scalar flux to the once-rounded RAW scalar response.
Place beside it, without subtraction or attribution, the exact binary32 representable-step displacement from PRE to the completed OFF production-map output.
Use both descriptive ledgers only to scope a later default-off REAL64 working-iteration experiment.

scope.accepted_input_scalar_domain: strictly positive finite EVAL and RAW values
scope.accepted_projection_domain: positive finite binary32 or positive underflow rounded to +0; gradual underflow is retained and conversion overflow is invalid

EVAL.meaning: captured binary32 primary input promoted exactly to binary64

RAW.meaning: post-STIS or volume-normalized primary MOC response before ACA and SCR, retained in binary64

PRE.meaning: binary32 input to the completed production step

OFF.meaning: binary32 output of the complete production step

record_contract.required_identity: EVAL must equal the exact binary64 promotion of PRE for every one of the 14 unknowns in every group

rounding_contract.operation: IEEE-754 roundTiesToEven from the exact stored binary64 RAW value to binary32
rounding_contract.result_requirement: positive finite binary32, or +0 produced by gradual underflow from a positive finite RAW value; NaN, infinity, negative zero and saturation are forbidden
rounding_contract.independent_replay: reconstruct the binary32 result directly from each published binary64 bit pattern and verify it against the reader output

ordered_key_contract.input: finite IEEE binary32 encoding z with unsigned magnitude m=bits(z)&0x7fffffff

definition.signed_zero: K(z)=0x80000000 when m=0, so +0 and -0 are one numerical lattice point

ordered_key_contract.step_arithmetic: signed binary64-width integer subtraction of ordered keys; never binary32 signed-integer subtraction
ordered_key_contract.current_positive_data_reduction: For the released strictly positive values, K(target)-K(reference) equals widened unsigned_bits(target)-unsigned_bits(reference).

RAW-BRIDGE.positive_direction: rounded RAW is numerically greater than EVAL

PRODUCTION-STEP.positive_direction: OFF is numerically greater than PRE

published_statistics: RAW-exact count where RAW64 is the exact promotion of EVAL32
round-collapsed-nonzero count where RAW differs from EVAL but the projected step is zero
every group-region-key tie at the largest absolute step
complete per-tuple ledger with RAW binary64 bits where applicable, both binary32 encodings, signed step and absolute step

fail_closed_conditions: parent evidence hash or census differs
input XSM aliases another input or changes during replay
record type, length, group identity, or key layout differs
EVAL is not an exact binary32 promotion
a retained EVAL or RAW scalar input is nonpositive or nonfinite
runtime rounding mode is not round-to-nearest
a positive finite RAW value converts to negative zero, NaN, or infinity
ledger order, arithmetic identity, census, histogram, maximum, or tie set does not close
reader source or binary contains an XSM mutation or transport-solver dependency

required_tests: binary32 encoding and adjacency at a binade boundary
binary64-to-binary32 exact, below-half, above-half, tie-to-even-down, and tie-to-even-up cases
distinguish RAW-exact from a nonzero RAW difference collapsed by projection
signed-zero ordered-key identity, gradual underflow to +0, subnormal retention, and conversion-overflow rejection
independent RAW, EVAL, PRE, OFF, group-marker, record-type, nonfinite, and nonpositive tamper rejection
input hash before and after replay
two byte-identical reader runs and two byte-identical independent checker runs
next_decision: After publication and independent replay, use only the observed representable-step scale and structure to define the smallest default-off REAL64 radial working-iteration experiment; do not change the physical equation.
